$comment: document shape: { query, count, results: [{ title, url, kind, note? }] } for the current page; route.pagination as in listing. site.search is { path, maxLength } (the form's action and the input's maxlength). labels: search (the h1), landmark, field, submit, results (the heading, with {n} the count and {q} the query), more, noResults, nav, previous, next, page (with {n}); kind shows the result's own kind word (Post, Page, Service) unchanged. The input keeps the query as its value (SC-019).
